name: Fiona Beckford
original_name: フィオナ・ベックフォード
source: Fiona is Lisa's classmate and best friend, she is also the closest to a family that Lisa could ever have. She's very protective of Lisa that she is very much a tsundere around Takahiro and even despises him that she would often be calling him names. It is hinted that both she and Lisa share the same kind family problems where they both feel alone and abandoned.
